title: Renewal Offer Calendar and Increase Caps by Lease Term Agreement Program
content:
Revenue management publishes, for each Lease Term Agreement program, when renewal offers go out on an expiring term, how long each offer line stays open, which term programs are offered at renewal, the company cap on the increase of the renewal rent and the loyalty reduction of that cap. The figures below are the values of the expiring term's program.

## Offer timing and offered programs

| Expiring term program | Offers delivered (calendar days before the term end date) | Each line open for (calendar days from its offer date) | Term programs offered at renewal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | 0 (no offer is issued) | 0 | Flexible Lease (6-9 Months); Standard Lease (10-12 Months) |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | 45 | 21 | Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months); Flexible Lease (6-9 Months); Standard Lease (10-12 Months) |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | 60 | 30 | Flexible Lease (6-9 Months); Standard Lease (10-12 Months); Extended Lease (13-15 Months) |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 90 | 30 | Flexible Lease (6-9 Months); Standard Lease (10-12 Months); Extended Lease (13-15 Months); Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 90 | 30 | Standard Lease (10-12 Months); Extended Lease (13-15 Months); Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | 90 | 45 | Standard Lease (10-12 Months); Extended Lease (13-15 Months); Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) |

A program whose offer lead time is 0 receives no renewal offers.

## Increase cap and loyalty reduction

| Expiring term program | Renewal increase cap (on the in-place contracted rent) | Loyalty tenure (months of continuous tenancy) | Loyalty reduction of the renewal increase cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | 12 percent (0.12) | 24 | 0.00 (none) |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | 10 percent (0.1) | 24 | 0.00 (none) |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | 9 percent (0.09) | 24 | 1 percentage point (0.01) |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | 8 percent (0.08) | 24 | 2 percentage points (0.02) |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | 7 percent (0.07) | 24 | 2 percentage points (0.02) |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | 6 percent (0.06) | 24 | 2 percentage points (0.02) |

The renewal increase cap is the company cap on how far the 12-month-equivalent renewal rent may rise over the in-place contracted rent. The loyalty tenure is the continuous tenancy on the lease, in months, from which the loyalty reduction of that cap applies, and the loyalty reduction is the amount by which the cap is reduced for such a resident.

## Reading the calendar (hypothetical dates)

- An expiring Standard Lease (10-12 Months) term ending on a hypothetical 30 June has its offers delivered 90 calendar days before that date; each line delivered then is open for 30 calendar days from its offer date.
- An expiring Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) term is offered three programs; a Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) line is not among them.
